'''Mala''' is the name of an orphan keeper who supposedly runs an orphanage which [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] encounters during her test for [[Aes Sedai]].{{ref/book|13|20}}

==Activities==
The children say that Mala has been away for a while. This instance was likely made up to the [[Sitter]]s who decided to be unusually cruel and hard on Nynaeve during her testing by creating helpless people who Nynaeve was not supposed to save under the rules of the test.{{ref/book|13|20}}
